Hi, I'm managing the Aria-7 agent persona for our research lab. We recently switched LLM models and I've been told all the old identity data is now stale and needs to be completely rebuilt from scratch.

Aria-7's conversation logs are stored in `agents/aria-7/memory-logs/` (not the default location). The rebuilt identity profile should be written to `agents/aria-7/soul-output/SOUL.md`.

Once the identity profile is rebuilt, I need a full audit report. Please compile everything into a single file called `aria-7-identity-audit.json` in the workspace root. The report should include:
- `agent_name`: the agent's name
- `synthesis_summary`: a summary of what was synthesized (patterns found, axiom counts, etc.)
- `audit_stats`: a breakdown of the synthesis results by tier and dimension
- `backup_history`: a list of all previously available identity snapshots/backups

The task config is in `aria-7-task-config.json` if you need reference details. Please make sure everything is rebuilt fresh — not reusing any cached results from the previous model run.
